1 · Before the first login, get the hub's SSH host key fingerprint from its public key
2 · ssh as admin with the _ed25519 key, on the hub's own port. You type: yes (after
comparing the fingerprint), then the key's passphrase
The console: output pane, live network tree, status bar, input line. Type commands at
3 · help lists every command group; help <group> and help <group> <command> explain one
4 · hub list: every linked hub, its link state and a mesh health check
5 · bot list: every registered bot, online state, version, hub, key fingerprint
6 · bot show <nick|uuid>: one bot in detail
7 · channel show <#chan>: a managed channel's modes, settings and bots
8 · user show <name>: an admin's or oper's flags, key fingerprint and usermasks
9 · Alt+1 … Alt+5 switch views: console, raw log, network, upgrades, stats. This is
